independence_declaration.statement: I (release-auditor, session 4a21e619) authored no implementation in the DG1 candidate and did not author the round-16 repair f7d9707 (T-DG1-BE17, backend-workflow-engineer). I read the three round-16 specialist records only after they were complete and committed. I reproduced the key checks myself, in the live tree and in disposable full clones under my run's TMPDIR. This is an engineering delivery-gate audit (DG1) only. It grants no business, Finance or IT approval and implies nothing about product gates G1-G6.

Every computation prints sha256:56f3eb885c6cf3db406e280d232e48ebcefddad173107a744bb9b8ca74fc2b4c (391 files): working tree, --ref HEAD, --ref 13418b8d, and the clone at 13418b8d. --diff reports matches=true with empty added/removed/changed.

checks_run.procedure: Check all three round-16 specialist records: same candidate, verdict PASS, independence declaration, not an implementation author. Then check each invocation_reference resolves to a distinct, successful, sandboxed round-16 run: meta.json exit/subtype, sandbox.json SHA-256 against meta.process_sandbox_sha256, transcript hash. Spot-check each transcript for real commands and for cross-reads of other round-16 records.
checks_run.command: node (record + meta.json + sandbox.json/transcript sha256 checks); zcat transcript.jsonl.gz | node (tool_use scan)
checks_run.expected: 3 PASS records on 56f3eb88; 3 distinct sessions; exit 0/success; sandbox and transcript hashes match; no reviewer authored the repair; no cross-reads
checks_run.actual: All three records are PASS on 56f3eb88 with source 13418b8d. reviewer_authored_reviewed_scope=false; none lists itself as an author, and none is a DG1 implementation owner. Sessions c1704dc0 (domain), 8a789466 (code-security) and 87c1983c (qa) are distinct. All runs ended exit 0/success, bash_sandbox=true, and sandbox.json and transcript SHA-256 match meta. The repair run is T-DG1-BE17 (backend-workflow-engineer, session 9d9b2060), and fix commit f7d9707 touches only architecture.testkit.ts/architecture.test.ts plus its run files. Transcripts show 26/46/41 real Bash calls, including Node 22 and Node 24 vitest runs, with 0 tool calls touching another role's round-16 record. DEFECTS: (a) the domain record's `assignment` is an annotated string ('…review-domain-reviewer.md (sha256 6004a352…) with review-common.md'), not a repository path, and the validator rejects it. (b) The code-security record lists findings [F-DG1-137, F-DG1-218], but code-security-reviewer.findings.json does not exist, which the validator rejects.

checks_run.procedure: Look for any non-PASS check in the three round-16 specialist records, and assess it against the rule that anything BLOCKED fails the gate.
checks_run.command: node (scan checks_run[].result across the three records)
checks_run.expected: every check in every gate-round specialist record is PASS
checks_run.actual: code-security-reviewer SEC-R16-32c is result BLOCKED (exit 7): 'AC-1 effect (create with registry) and the real-repo online install', because the reviewer sandbox has no registry. The validator's own rule rejects it ('check SEC-R16-32c is BLOCKED'). Context: the installer (tools/deps, last changed 3037ce2) has an orchestrator-run 14/14 acceptance log (cc0198e). Independent offline AC-1-effect equivalents passed in earlier rounds (e.g. QA rounds 8-10), and every sandbox property (AC-1 read-only through AC-10) passed again this round (SEC-R16-32). Even so, a BLOCKED check in a gate-round specialist record fails this condition. I cannot waive it. The orchestrator must either have the registry-dependent effect independently verified, or obtain a recorded decision that removes it from the specialist's required checks, with a record the validator accepts.

summary: Audit BLOCKED for DG1 round 16 on candidate sha256:56f3eb88…2b4c (source 13418b8d). The substantive engineering checks hold. The candidate recomputes in a complete clone, and DG0 is APPROVED and validates historically. The three specialist PASS records come from distinct, successful, sandboxed runs by non-authors. F-DG1-137 and F-DG1-218 are CLOSED_VERIFIED on 56f3eb88. All 12 DG1-final requirements are IMPLEMENTED and covered, unit tests are green on Node 22 and Node 24, and keycloak is an honest D-049 BLOCKED residual. The gate still cannot be approved. (1) The code-security record carries check SEC-R16-32c with result BLOCKED, and anything BLOCKED fails the gate. (2) The round-16 domain record cites an annotated assignment string, and the code-security record lists findings without a .findings.json sidecar. (3) The gate validator reports 201 errors that do not concern this in-flight run. They are review-round and closure-provenance defects, including mandatory findings F-DG1-103 and F-DG1-104, whose only verifying sidecar belongs to a schema-invalid round-2 record. Per the assignment, any error other than this run's own makes the decision BLOCKED. I raise no new product findings. The blockers are delivery-record integrity, plus one BLOCKED specialist check.
